patthana19.12:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana19.12:3.1: na parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parittārammaṇo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana19.12:5.1: na hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca majjhimo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana19.12:7.1: na micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sammattaniyato dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana19.12:9.1: na maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, dasa.
